title: TOEFL Preparation Course – Extensive Course
overview: This intensive TOEFL preparation course develops the academic English proficiency, test-taking judgment, and timed performance required for the TOEFL iBT. Through diagnostic assessment, focused practice in Reading, Listening, Speaking, and Writing, integrated-skills tasks, and structured feedback, participants learn to respond accurately and efficiently under examination conditions. The 15-day format prioritizes high-impact strategies, deliberate practice, and individual improvement plans. Test tasks and timing are reviewed against the format applicable at the time of delivery.
audience: Students preparing for admission to English-medium universities and colleges.
Professionals seeking an English-language proficiency score for academic or professional requirements.
Learners with intermediate or higher English proficiency who need intensive TOEFL preparation.
Candidates retaking the TOEFL who wish to address identified performance gaps.
methodology: Trainer-led strategy demonstrations, diagnostic and timed practice tests, academic reading and listening exercises, speaking recordings, writing workshops, peer review, individualized corrective feedback, integrated-skills simulations, and a final mock examination. Progress is tracked using performance rubrics and targeted improvement exercises.
competencies: Academic reading comprehension, inference, and information synthesis.
Listening comprehension and effective academic note-taking.
Clear, organized, intelligible spoken responses under time limits.
Accurate, coherent academic writing and source integration.
Time management, question analysis, self-monitoring, and test readiness.
objectivesIntro: By the end of this course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify TOEFL iBT section requirements, question types, scoring criteria, and examination procedures.
Apply efficient strategies to understand academic passages and spoken material.
Organize and deliver relevant spoken responses with appropriate fluency and clarity.
Plan, compose, and revise written responses using accurate language and logical organization.
Integrate information from reading and listening sources without distorting meaning.
Manage test time, evaluate errors, and implement a personalized improvement plan.
